message.reasoning_content: Cayenne is Harrison instrumental. Dig It is Lennon-McCartney. You Like Me Too Much is Harrison. I Me Mine is Harrison. Hmm, none solely Lennon. Lennon-McCartney... Dig It credited Lennon–McCartney. So Dig It.
